name: owasp-juice-shop
description: OWASP Juice Shop (bkimminich/juice-shop). Every issue below was verified by hand against a local container (benchmark/docker-compose.yml) on 2026-11-14 with harmless probes. Only issues reachable by an external web scanner are listed - client-side-only, CAPTCHA, and pure business-logic challenges are intentionally excluded. Recall is expected to be partial: a single-page app serves most endpoints through JavaScript XHR, which an external crawler only partly discovers. This file is a yardstick for improvement, not a pass/fail gate.
run: docker compose -f benchmark/docker-compose.yml up -d juice-shop ; python benchmark/run_benchmark.py --url http://127.0.0.1:3000 --expected benchmark/juice-shop.expected.json --nuclei

expected.note: verified: email with a single quote -> 500 DB error (JSON body)
verified: /metrics exposes Prometheus metrics (102 HELP/TYPE lines)
verified: full application configuration returned unauthenticated
